svg.text: SocialStream — round 3: G with H's tilt
G's phone S and wordmark, tilted 15° as in H. Three ways to handle the slice. Greyscale on purpose.

svg.text: G2 · Slice parallel to the A
G tilted 15° like H; the cut stays at 15°,
parallel to your A, so symbol and wordmark
The cut turns with the phone and ends up
level; calmer, but reads more like a phone
H's tilted phone next to G's wordmark; the
cleanest, but loses the link to your A.
